methodology.formation: All eligible names at each source month end in 2024–2025; original dollar-cap buckets frozen, later eligibility does not drop names.
methodology.budget: Fixed USD notional per original name, not a share-accounting liquidation or a strategy portfolio. Credit subsequent observed daily native amount × 1000 × strictly prior feature FX × participation.
methodology.guarded: Full-suspension dates credit zero unless contradicted by positive daily turnover. Any daily lower-limit touch discards the entire day for a conservative sell sensitivity. Other daily turnover is arithmetic only, not evidence of fillability.
methodology.missing: Unknown daily/limit/price evidence receives no credit and remains unknown. Sufficient known credit can cover a budget despite other missing days; otherwise unknowns remain unresolved.
methodology.pooling: Annual statistics pool original stock–formation observations. Day percentiles condition on covered names; maximum is missing unless every original name is covered. Top-decile share pools uncredited balances across formations.
methodology.limits: No fees, shares, board lots, endogenous price impact, price-path inventory valuation, queues or historical receive timestamps. Raw mode ignores price-limit constraints; guarded mode is a sensitivity, not a lower bound on actual execution.
